_note: Email templates for the Make.com follow-up scenarios. The Make scenario fetches this file from https://riketpatel.com/data/email-templates.json, picks the template by template_id, interpolates {placeholders}, creates a Gmail DRAFT in riketpatel@gmail.com (never auto-sends — Riket reviews and clicks send per the Drafts-Only rule).

placeholders.{recipient_name}: Person being addressed (defaults to 'team' if not provided)
placeholders.{recipient_email}: Recipient email (used as Gmail To: field, not in body)
